tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
PLEASE REFER FOR ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER ATTACHED TENDER DOCUMNET

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have successfully supplied metals to any Government Sector / Major PSU / Power Plants / Private Sector / Industry amounting to Rs 9.22 lakhs or above in the preceding five years. In proof of the same, the bidder shall upload supportive documents (Purchase Orders/Supply Orders limited to two numbers) issued by the competent authority.
The bidder shall be a Manufacturer / Authorized Dealer of Metals. As documentary proof, the bidder shall submit Manufacturer Certificate / Authorization Certificate.

The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs18.44 lakhs in at least two financial years during the preceding five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26). As proof, the bidder shall furnish an Annual Turnover Certificate / Profit & Loss Statement duly certified by a Chartered Accountant.
